apps/web/components/features/home/HomeNo.long-content: The card takes no props and renders the fixed HOME_AUTO_NOTIFY_CONTENT sender and release line; there is no caller text to lengthen.

apps/web/components/features/home/HomeSt.empty: The section owns no collection: the detector matched `{ARC_OFFSETS.map((y, i) => (`, six fixed decorative arcs.

apps/web/components/features/home/label-.empty: The lockups own no collection: the detector matched the class in `'inline-flex items-center justify-center select-none text-on-media/92'`.
apps/web/components/features/home/label-.partial: Each lockup takes only className (and the image logo a style); there is no optional content that could be missing.
apps/web/components/features/home/label-.long-content: The marks are fixed brand wordmarks (disco:wax, Blanco y Negro, rec play) with no caller-supplied text to lengthen.
apps/web/components/features/home/label-.permission-denied: No gated action: the detector matched `role='img'` on each lockup.

apps/web/components/features/library-ass.empty: The page shows one shared asset and owns no collection: the detector matched the class in `'inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-2xs'`. Missing artwork, preview and link are the partial state (PartialNoArtworkPublic).

apps/web/components/features/library-ass.error: A failed clipboard write shows no error UI: `} catch {\n        setCopied(false);` leaves the idle copy button, which LibraryAssetShareUrlCell.test.tsx covers.

apps/web/components/features/library-sha.empty: The card renders one asset and owns no collection: the detector matched the class in `'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2'`. The empty press kit belongs to LibraryShareAssetLayouts.

apps/web/components/features/pay/EmptySt.partial: The optional props are className, animate and rows; the heading, description and illustration are fixed per type, so no content can be partly present.
apps/web/components/features/pay/EmptySt.long-content: The heading and description are fixed copy from EMPTY_STATE_CONFIG; there is no caller-supplied text to lengthen.
apps/web/components/features/pay/EmptySt.offline: The card and skeleton are presentational and fetch nothing: the detector matched the words in `LoadingSkeleton` and `TippingMetricsSkeleton`.

apps/web/components/features/pitch/Inves.empty: The lists map the checked-in fundraisingRegistry (coreSlides, operatingLoop, risks, appendix), which is never empty at build time; there is no runtime collection to empty.
apps/web/components/features/pitch/Inves.permission-denied: The brief renders only inside the gated portal route, which owns the access check and its not-found response; the body has no gated state of its own. The detector matched the comment `Gated with the portal`.

apps/web/components/features/pmf-survey/.empty: The card owns no collection that can be empty: the detector matched `{CHOICES.map(option => {`, the three fixed survey answers.
apps/web/components/features/pmf-survey/.permission-denied: Every signed-in user can answer or dismiss the survey; there is no gated action. The detector matched `role='region'` on the card.
